what: Drive bus address 12 is used twice.
where: Drives of pumps P-101 and P-102
why: Pack modbus-drive-bus, rule unique-address: each device on a Modbus line needs its own address.
fix: Give the P-102 drive a free address, such as 13.

what: The bus isn't terminated at its last drive.
where: Drive of pump P-104, the end of the bus
why: Pack modbus-drive-bus, rule end-termination: an unterminated RS-485 line reflects signals.
fix: Fit the termination at the P-104 drive.

why: The value 7.5 kW came from an agent and is marked inferred.
fix: Confirm it from the pump's data sheet.

what: Two spare terminals remain on strip X1.
why: Pack site-basics, rule spare-terminals: spares are counted for the installer.
